Reference

Equipment

Every piece in the game's equipment table, by the season it belongs to and the slot it fills, with its main stat from the level curve, the secondary stats it can roll and the set it counts toward. Names, qualities, slots and set bonuses are the game's own text.

How a piece is valued

CalcEquipMainProps reads the piece's main stat off its level curve and multiplies it twice: once by the upgrade level (the +N you pay materials for) and once by a fixed quality factor. Season Enhancement goes on top of that — the game's tooltip: "Gear Enhancement Level 0 + Season Level 1", "Season Enhancement provides gear power boosts beyond your current Rank's cap" — and only counts while your promotion matches the piece's (the config calls it "bless").

main = curve[level] x (1 + upgrade[+N]) x (1 + quality)   (+ season enhancement[b] while the promotion matches)

The secondary stat uses the same shape on its own curve. The piece's level is your level clamped to the piece's own level (EquipInfo.GetLevel); every piece here has no level extension, so a levelled piece is fixed at its level and a drop that scales takes the level it fell at.

The seasons

Each row of astrological_season_config names a season and a promotion family, and the gear levels in the equipment table land exactly on those families' level caps. That is the grouping below: a season's gear is the gear at its promotion's cap.

  • Season 1 Witching Hours — Expert, gear level 100
  • Season 2 Crossed Paths — Champion, gear level 130
  • Season 3 Finale of Chaos — Master, gear level 160
  • Season 4 Bizarre Spectacle — Paragon, gear level 190
  • Season 5 Frostfire Anthem — Saint, gear level 220
  • Season 6 Season 6 — Ascendant, gear level 250

Sets

Two pieces of a set give the stat pair; four give the effect. Where a bonus fires a skill, the value that skill uses sits on its prefab rather than in the equipment tables, and the line says so instead of guessing.

Repulsion Lv 100

  • 2 pieces — ATK +20%, DEF +20%
  • 4 pieces — The wearer takes (the skill's own value) less Technique DMG when shielded.

Barrier Lv 100

  • 2 pieces — HP +20%, SPD +20%
  • 4 pieces — Triggers Wind Shield before battle starts.

Repression Lv 100

  • 2 pieces — DMG Boost +4%, ATK +20%
  • 4 pieces — The wearer deals (the skill's own value) more Technique DMG to frozen and stunned enemies.

Heartsear Lv 100

  • 2 pieces — Crit Rate +8%, ATK +20%
  • 4 pieces — When taking Technique DMG, the wearer has a 15% chance to trigger Fire Ring.

Thunder Wrath Lv 100

  • 2 pieces — Crit Rate +8%, Crit DMG +12%
  • 4 pieces — When an enemy within 3 grids of the wearer moves, the wearer has a 34% chance to trigger Thunder Strike.

Balanced not on a levelled piece

  • 2 pieces — ATK +20%, DEF +20%
  • 4 pieces — Crit Rate +8%, Block Rate +8%

Assimilation Lv 130

  • 2 pieces — DMG RES +4%, DEF +20%
  • 4 pieces — When taking Technique DMG, the wearer has a 25% chance to trigger Auto Protection.

Indomitable Lv 130

  • 2 pieces — DMG Boost +4%, ATK +20%
  • 4 pieces — Triggers Urgent Protection the first time the wearer takes fatal DMG.

Cratering Lv 130

  • 2 pieces — ATK +20%, SPD +20%
  • 4 pieces — When landing, the wearer has a 45% chance to trigger Assault.

Ephemeral Lv 130

  • 2 pieces — DEF +20%, HP +20%
  • 4 pieces — When taking Technique DMG, the wearer has a 12% chance to teleport to any empty grid within 2 grids.

Pursuit Lv 130

  • 2 pieces — Accuracy +8%, SPD +20%
  • 4 pieces — When dealing DMG with a Technique, the wearer has a 22.5% chance to trigger Chi Explosion.

Masterful Lv 130

  • 2 pieces — Crit Rate +8%, SPD +20%
  • 4 pieces — After casting a Technique, the wearer has a 23% chance to reset its CD and cast again. Can trigger up to 0.01% times per turn.

Trial by Fire Lv 130

  • 2 pieces — Block Rate +8%, SPD +20%
  • 4 pieces — After moving, the wearer has a 45% chance to trigger Magma.

Cold Lv 130

  • 2 pieces — Block Rate +8%, HP +20%
  • 4 pieces — When taking Technique DMG, the wearer has a 16% chance to inflict Frozen on the attacker for 1 turn.

Chanting Prelude Lv 130

  • 2 pieces — Crit Rate +8%, Crit DMG +12%
  • 4 pieces — Reduces the first Technique's CD in the current loadout by 1 turn.

Bulwark Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — Block Rate +10%, DEF +25%
  • 4 pieces — When blocking a Technique attack, the wearer has a 30% chance to trigger Energy Absorption, up to 0.05% time(s) per turn.

Eidolon Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — HP +25%, SPD +25%
  • 4 pieces — Triggers Voltjaw Beast Summon before battle starts.

Ferocity Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — Crit Rate +10%, ATK +25%
  • 4 pieces — Triggers Obsession each time lethal DMG is taken.

Anchor Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — ATK +25%, DEF +25%
  • 4 pieces — At the start of the wearer's turn, the wearer has a 100% chance to trigger Unshakable.

Purify Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — Accuracy +10%, HP +25%
  • 4 pieces — At the start of the wearer's turn, the wearer has a 40% chance to trigger Purify.

Divine Step Lv 160, Lv 220

  • 2 pieces — Crit Rate +10%, SPD +25%
  • 4 pieces — Triggers Divine Step before battle starts.

Fervor Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — HP +25%, SPD +25%
  • 4 pieces — When healing an ally with a Technique, the wearer has a 30% chance to advance the ally's action bar by 20%.

Soul Devour Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — Crit Rate +10%, ATK +25%
  • 4 pieces — When killing an enemy, the wearer triggers Soul Devour, up to 0.02% time(s) per turn.

Antecedent Lv 160, Lv 220

  • 2 pieces — DEF +25%, SPD +25%
  • 4 pieces — At the start of the wearer's turn, the wearer has a 30% chance to trigger Lifemanship, up to 0.02% time(s) per battle.

Echo Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — DMG RES +5%, HP +25%
  • 4 pieces — When the wearer's summon dies or expires, the wearer has a 75% chance to trigger Soulbond Echo, up to 0.02% time(s) per turn.

Ripple Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — ATK +25%, SPD +25%
  • 4 pieces — At the start of the wearer's turn, the wearer has a 30% chance to trigger Water Blast.

Reign Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — Block Rate +10%, HP +25%
  • 4 pieces — Triggers Scarecrow before battle starts.

Rampage Lv 160

  • 2 pieces — DMG Boost +5%, DMG RES +5%
  • 4 pieces — When dealing DMG with a Technique, the wearer has a 60% chance to trigger Frenzy Shark. Can trigger only twice every 2 turns.

Divination Lv 190

  • 2 pieces — ATK +25%, SPD +25%
  • 4 pieces — Triggers Divination before battle starts.

Thorn Lash Lv 190

  • 2 pieces — Block Rate +10%, DEF +25%
  • 4 pieces — At the end of enemy turns within a 1-grid square area of the wearer, there is a 100% chance to trigger Thorn Lash.

Insight Lv 190

  • 2 pieces — Crit Rate +10%, ATK +25%
  • 4 pieces — When an enemy blocks Technique DMG dealt, the wearer has a 80% chance to trigger Insight.

Fortitude Lv 190

  • 2 pieces — Block Rate +10%, HP +25%
  • 4 pieces — When taking Technique Crit DMG, the wearer has a 80% chance to trigger Fortitude.

Resonance Lv 190

  • 2 pieces — HP +25%, SPD +25%
  • 4 pieces — Triggers Resonance when the wearer has a summon on the battlefield.

Wind Slash Lv 190

  • 2 pieces — Accuracy +10%, DEF +25%
  • 4 pieces — When taking Technique DMG, the wearer has a 40% chance to trigger Wind Slash, up to 0.03% times per turn.

Backlash Lv 190

  • 2 pieces — Crit RES +10%, SPD +25%
  • 4 pieces — Whenever inflicted with Ailments or Debuffs, the wear has a 80% chance to trigger Backlash, up to 0.05% times per turn.

Fervor Lv 190

  • 2 pieces — HP +25%, SPD +25%
  • 4 pieces — When killing an enemy, the wearer triggers Fervor, up to 1 time per turn.

Ghostfire Bloom Lv 190

  • 2 pieces — Crit Rate +10%, ATK +25%
  • 4 pieces — Triggers Ghostfire Bloom the first time the wearer takes fatal DMG.
